name: Love, Sin & Evil
source:
A student falls into a trap set by an ancient evil. She must risk her soul in a bloody struggle for her life and the lives of her companions.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Love,_Sin_%26_Evil]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
一名学生落入了远古邪恶所设下的陷阱。她必须冒着生命危险，为自己和同伴的生命进行一场血腥的斗争。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Love,_Sin_%26_Evil]romance-club.fandom[/url]
